objective: KL Season 2: automatically grade each manuscript-backed 3/3 reading quiz with no required admin quiz review, and unlock the next chapter/series only after the reader posts a 20+ character own, nondeleted, top-level comment after the verified quiz.
environment: DEV only; no migrations applied to MAIN, no live/RC OTA, no paid build, no production promotion.
productionBaselineEvidence: On November 23, 2026, read-only MAIN Supabase schema inspection confirmed public.kl_episode_comments(author_id, parent_id, deleted_at, body, created_at) and unchanged admin/reader RPC contracts. MAIN lacks KL S2 rollout/progress migration. Latest parent DEV PR #1148 is draft, not merged.
chosenApproach: Additive isolated S2 SQL migration: reuse existing auth-scoped 3/3 quiz verification, add nondeleted post-quiz 20+ character comment predicate to the shared server access gate, enforce cross-series completion, repair comment reward trigger author identity, allow legacy pre-S2 completed sessions to retake quiz, expose accurate server progress. Automatically generate/retry the question bank after manuscript approval and during release preflight; no human quiz review step.
selectionRationale: Client-only locks or read-only completed_at are bypassable by old apps. Using an account-scoped SQL predicate shared by read, media, quiz, comments, session and progress preserves security while removing admin quiz review. The +5 BP reward must use real author_id not nonexistent user_id.
preserveBehaviors: Season 1 live quiz/timer, legacy reader, released manuscripts/media and current +10/+50 BP unchanged while S2 rollout flag is OFF.
Quiz passes only at server-graded 3 of 3 with current manuscript hash; client never sends correct answers or points.
Chapter N+1 requires a qualifying comment after quiz on every previous chapter, including the preceding entire 30-chapter series; drafts/unreleased chapters remain inaccessible.
Do not award extra points for repeated, deleted, reply, pre-quiz or non-meaningful comments; preserve existing +5 one-time credit and pending chapter-point rules.
Preserve Admin role, media preview and release controls; only remove mandatory human quiz answer review.
No production/staging data writes, Expo/EAS/Vercel deployment, ads/navigation changes or automatic Season 2 activation.
acceptanceChecks: Admin manuscript approval immediately requests automatic question-bank preparation; publication re-attempts automatically when bank is pending; no admin review required.
Reader 3/3 quiz is auto verified; chapter remains locked until a server-accepted post-quiz 20+ character comment by same account.
Comment before quiz, other member, reply, deleted, short comment or mismatched manuscript never opens next chapter or awards +5.
Existing completed legacy session without verified attempt can retake quiz in S2; server never double-credits completion.
Cross-series Panimula and Chapter 1 remain locked until 30 preceding chapters each have verified quiz and comment.
Old app and direct RPC cannot read manuscript, media, start sessions, quiz or post comments out of order.
Focused source, SQL guard and TypeScript tests pass; live staging PostgreSQL behavioral tests remain separate release gates.
alternativeApproaches: Admin manually reviews and approves each member quiz (rejected: user wants automatic verification; bottleneck).
Unlock immediately on quiz pass without comment (rejected: violates explicit engagement gate).
Client-only comment count and local unlock (rejected: easy bypass, cross-account, stale and deleted comments).
